scenario.title: Environmental Monitoring System
scenario.summary: An ESP32 environmental monitor reads a DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor, shows the readings on an SSD1306 OLED, and drives an LED alert and an L293D fan when the temperature reaches 31 C. It has no Wi-Fi or MQTT and reports over USB serial. This package establishes the panel's firmware and hardware identity only; no training activity or vulnerability is defined yet.

guide.heading: The system
paragraphs: The Environmental Monitoring System is an ESP32 environmental monitor. A DHT11 sensor measures temperature and relative humidity every two seconds, and an SSD1306 OLED display shows the readings.
When the temperature reaches 31.0 C the system blinks an alert LED and runs a fan through an L293D motor driver. It is not network-connected; it reports its readings over USB serial at 115200 baud.

guide.heading: Current state of this panel
paragraphs: No cybersecurity training activity is defined for this panel yet. It has no objectives and no hints in Hack Mode.
The terminal and its tools remain available, but no objectives are tracked for this panel. Build Mode can still open, edit and flash its firmware.
